description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class `CriteriaInvestMatcherProcessorTest` that tests the functionality of the `CriteriaInvestMatcherProcessor` class within the Goteo project. It includes setup, multiple test methods for creating matchers, users, projects, investments, and testing the processor's behavior in various scenarios.

classes.name: CriteriaInvestMatcherProcessorTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class that verifies the behavior of the `CriteriaInvestMatcherProcessor` class within the Goteo project, covering creation, configuration, user and project association, amount calculations, investments, and cleanup.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Creates and validates a new Matcher instance for testing.

methods.name: testAddUsers
methods.description: Adds user data to the matcher, creating users if necessary, and verifies total amount calculations.

methods.name: testCreateConfig
methods.description: Configures the matcher with specific variables for criteria processing.

methods.name: testAddProjects
methods.description: Associates a project with the matcher.

methods.name: testInstance
methods.description: Creates an instance of CriteriaInvestMatcherProcessor based on the matcher.

methods.name: testId
methods.description: Verifies the ID of the processor.

methods.name: testName
methods.description: Verifies the name provided by the processor.

methods.name: testVars
methods.description: Tests retrieval and setting of variables in the processor.

methods.name: testAmount
methods.description: Checks the amount calculation logic within the processor for investments.

methods.name: testUserAmounts
methods.description: Verifies distribution of amounts per user.

methods.name: testInvests
methods.description: Checks the investments retrieved by the processor.

methods.name: testInvestsRepeat
methods.description: Tests behavior with repeated investments.

methods.name: testCreateConfigAmount
methods.description: Configures minimum amount per project for testing.

methods.name: testCleanInvests
methods.description: Removes investment entries to reset state.

methods.name: testRefillUsersPool
methods.description: Refills user pools and verifies total amounts after reset.

methods.name: testAmountByAmount
methods.description: Tests amount calculation logic when setting explicit amounts.

methods.name: testInvestsByAmount
methods.description: Verifies investments retrieved in amount-based scenarios.

methods.name: testInvestsRepeatByAmount
methods.description: Verifies repeated investments with amount-based logic.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Deletes investments and the matcher instance to clean up.

methods.name: testCleanUsers
methods.description: Deletes test users and associated investments to reset state.

methods.name: tearDownAfterClass
methods.description: Performs cleanup after all tests in the class have run.
